norm_sql: select car_makers.id , car_makers.maker from car_makers join model_list on car_makers.id = model_list.maker group by car_makers.id having count ( * ) >= 2 intersect select car_makers.id , car_makers.maker from car_makers join model_list on car_makers.id = model_list.maker join car_names on model_list.model = car_names.model group by car_makers.id having count ( * ) > 3
sql_skeleton: select _ from _ group by _ having count ( _ ) >= _ intersect select _ from _ group by _ having count ( _ ) > _
natsql: select car_makers.Id , car_makers.Maker from car_makers  where  count ( model_list.* )  >= 2  and  count ( car_names.* )  > 3  group by car_makers.Id
norm_natsql: select car_makers.id , car_makers.maker from car_makers where count ( model_list.* ) >= 2 and count ( car_names.* ) > 3 group by car_makers.id

sql_skeleton: select count ( _ ) from _ where _ not in ( select _ from _ where _ )
natsql: select count ( visitor.* )  from visitor  where  @.@ not in visit.*  and  museum.Open_Year > 2010

natsql_skeleton: select count ( _ ) from _ where @.@ not in _ and _
